## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

Owns sending mail and the sent-mail journal, and nothing about the features
that send it. It must not import a feature module: each one registers its own
deliverer, wired at composition time in `src/api/mailJobRegistrations.ts`.

The queue is retried with backoff and gives up into a dead state rather than
looping. A kind with no registered deliverer fails loudly as
`unknown_mail_kind` instead of silently discarding the mail.

<!-- invariants:end -->
